title: Audit workflow security reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for audit workflow security should include: permissions:, secrets, pull_request_target.
answer.example:
name: Harden a validation workflow
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: validation-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "Run non-privileged checks"
answer.verification: The workflow uses read-only repository permissions, a bounded timeout, and a concurrency group that cancels outdated validation runs. Review cancellation behavior before applying this pattern to deployments.
